notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, chrome impersonation) hit a DataDome CAPTCHA wall (403 with geo.captcha-delivery.com challenge) on robots.txt and homepage. Tier (b) Playwright/CDP headless hit the same DataDome CAPTCHA iframe. Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome, which passed the DataDome check via the logged-in Chrome session and rendered the site normally. TREE: navigated the site's Home department (/c/home) and read its own left-sidebar Category refine list (union with sub-category strips on each node) to build the tree: Holiday & Christmas, Kitchen, Home Decor, Bedding, Dining & Entertaining, Luggage & Travel Gear, Household Tech, Bath, Home Storage & Organization, Lighting. Confirmed each recorded leaf's h1/selected-category matched the requested slug. QTY: read the rendered 'N Items' header on each category/subcategory listing page (Salesforce Commerce Cloud SPA render, e.g. 'DUVET COVERS & PILLOW SHAMS 175 Items'); no product-count API was used. EXCLUDED: Kitchen (Coffee & Tea, Kitchen Appliances, Kitchen Tools & Accessories, Knives - no kitchen-textile subcategory, all hard goods); Bath > Bath Accessories (48 items, all hard goods - dispensers, trays, toothbrush holders, tissue boxes, trash bin - no textile/storage primary purpose); Home Decor > Accent Furniture & Rugs (56 items - predominantly furniture/accent tables/bar stools with only 2-3 individual curtain products embedded and no dedicated Rugs or Curtains subcategory URL to isolate them, so skipped as mixed/non-isolable rather than fabricating a partial count); Home Decor > Books, Bowls/Vases/Trays, Candles & Diffusers, Games & Entertainment, Home Accents (273 items, pure decorative objects/sculptures/trinket boxes), Picture Frames, Plants and Flowers, Wall Decor & Mirrors (none textile/storage primary-purpose); Dining & Entertaining > Table Linens & Accessories (143 items - this single flat node mixes genuine table textiles (tablecloths, table runners, some placemats) with non-textile hard-good table accessories (napkin rings, napkin holders, coasters, capiz/lacquer placemats) with no separate textile-only subcategory URL, so it was excluded rather than reporting a qty that would misrepresent a textile-only count - MANUAL REVIEW candidate if a future pass can isolate tablecloths/runners individually); Holiday & Christmas (496 items - seasonal landing/collection department per rule exclusion, no dedicated textile or storage subcategory among Holiday Gourmet Food & Candy, Ornaments & Christmas Tree Decorations, Holiday Decor, Holiday Dining & Entertaining, Hanukkah Decorations); Luggage & Travel Gear (191 items - travel bags/suitcases explicitly excluded as personal-carrying items, not home storage); Household Tech and Lighting (out of scope departments). Home Storage & Organization (156 items) is a flat leaf category (jewelry boxes, watch boxes/winders, jewelry cases, catchall trays, organizational rolls) with no further subcategories, recorded as Storage per its own category URL.
